setting.idle_minutes: Minutes before letting go of the DB
settingHelp.host:
127.0.0.1: this PC only (default).
0.0.0.0 (or ::): also other devices such as a Quest. They pair with the code on the Status tab. The code and tokens travel unencrypted, so use this only on a network you trust, such as at home (a Quest on USB works with 127.0.0.1).
Empty restores the default.
settingHelp.port: The port to listen on (1-65535). Empty: the default ({default}), where OctantPath on this PC looks. 0: the OS picks one at each start (OctantPath on this PC can no longer find it).
settingHelp.start_at_login: On: start OctantCompass without a window when you log in to this PC (a systemd user unit on Linux, so `systemctl --user stop octantcompass` stops it, or the autostart folder without systemd; Startup on Windows). It does not load the DB until a paired environment asks (with the DB idle time set to 0 it loads it at the start). Default: off.
settingHelp.idle_minutes: After this many minutes without a request from a paired environment, the DB is let go to free memory (a loaded DB uses about 2 GB). The DB is also not loaded at the start; the next request loads it. 0: load at the start and keep it. Empty: the default ({default}).
settingHelp.index_url: https URL of the contract 5 index. Empty: none.
settingHelp.allow_unsigned_db: Development only: no warning for DB versions with no manifest.sig when importing. Unsigned versions are used with a warning even when this is off.
settingHelp.trusted_keys: One per line: the keyId, a space, the Ed25519 public key (base64). Empty: OctantVector's bundled keys only.
settingHelp.pair_code_attempts: Wrong tries before the code stops working.
settingHelp.log_lines: Lines of the log kept in memory.
